company.name: Kujiale
company.shortDescription: Kujiale is a SaaS-enabled home decoration and design platform.
company.description:
Kujiale is an online information and design platform that offers information and reviews on businesses related to home decoration and furnishing. It was launched by Hang Chen and is operated from Hangzhou, China.

Create 3D models, swap textures, and apply them in cutting-edge floor planning software. Visualize in 360-degree views, augmented reality, photo-realistic rendering, or virtual reality.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based 3D design platform for creating home decoration, interior, and spatial design plans with floor plans, 3D models, renderings, and design documentation.
productsAndServices.name: Kujiale Cloud Design Platform

productsAndServices.description: A business-oriented version of Kujiale that supports professional design operations, customer projects, and workflows for decoration, furniture, property, and other spatial-design companies.
